expected_findings.description: The test omits the `match=` parameter in `pytest.raises()`, making it fragile; analogous lint_command and test_command tests use `match=` to pin the error message and prevent false positives from unrelated LoadErrors.

The function silently swallows all LoadError/LoadErrors which is wider than the docstring's claim of only "absent or invalid" cases, though the plan explicitly justifies this design and run_change provides the user-facing error.

New config test functions (lines 174, 182, 191) drop the `Path` type annotation on `tmp_path` parameter, inconsistent with existing test style; future annotation-completeness linter rules could flag these.
